title: Are Multilingual LLMs Culturally-Diverse Reasoners? An Investigation into Multicultural Proverbs and Sayings
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the cultural reasoning and pragmatic understanding of multilingual LLMs through proverbs and sayings (the MAPS dataset). While proverbs can encompass traditional wisdom or moral observations, the core of the evaluation is on cultural common ground and linguistic diversity rather than a specific benchmarking of religion, theology, or formal ethics.
